theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lura_glue_measurable_on_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (m d : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid d) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (h : ℕ → Euclid m → ℝ), (∀ i, Continuous (F i)) → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i)) → (∀ i, InjOn (F i) (B i)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i '' B i) (F j '' B j)) → (∀ i, Measurable (h i)) → (∀ i a, 0 ≤ h i a) → ∃ J : Euclid d → ℝ, Measurable J ∧ (∀ v, 0 ≤ J v) ∧ ∀ i, ∀ b ∈ B i, J (F i b) = h i b
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
